subject: gk
question: Mera Houchongba is an important festival to celebrate peace in which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Manipur: Annual festival - Mera Houchongba to be celebrated in Imphal.
 
• In Manipur, the annual festival - Mera Houchongba will be celebrated at Kangla in Imphal.
 
• The festival is held to foster and consolidate relations among hill tribes and valley people of the State.
 
• Manipur Chief Minister N. Biren Singh along with the titular king of Manipur and Member of Rajya Sabha Leishemba Sanajaoba will inaugurate the festival at Kangla, the erstwhile royal palace of Manipur. A ritual ceremony will be held there.
